# Opentrons labware reference

`corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat-v1.json` is an unmodified copy of the official
Opentrons labware definition at commit
`759045308b15973bae25204a580d8cf91f95fd44`:

https://github.com/Opentrons/opentrons/blob/759045308b15973bae25204a580d8cf91f95fd44/shared-data/labware/definitions/2/corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat/1.json

Retrieved 2026-11-19. Original SHA-256:
`c13f112e52893e781c59ced9e6418ff10a5e2cc4b4877fd9559045f2f475558d`.
The original Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` from the same revision accompany
the definition. Their byte checksums and URLs are recorded in
`model/pipetting-labware.shared.json`.

This is an automation-provider labware coordinate definition, not a complete
manufacturer solid, measured calibration or safety qualification of PS01.
The adapter derives a centered display envelope and cylindrical well cavities;
the original coordinate and volume data are retained without editing.
